set.body:
Provide a usable public client contract and a minimal offline transfer package for a disclosed release or prepared view.

Acceptance criteria

1. A client built from the published contract discovers a permitted release and verifies delivery. CI checks the maintained API against the packaged server.
2. A second empty installation independently verifies a release and a restricted view, retains authorized origin evidence, and accepts them under its own custodian and grants.
3. The receipt states what the receiver verified about content and what establishes issuer identity. Source and receiver can independently end future access.

Verification

INT04 two-installation handoff and an independent verifier with frozen format examples.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: EP12: Exchange an exact release between independently operated repositories
